subject.title: [Feature]: Support arbitrary workspace files in bootstrap context injection

question: Should OpenClaw accept explicitly configured custom-basename workspace files as a core `bootstrap-extra-files` startup-context contract?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally constrain extra bootstrap injection to known workspace filenames, while the requested behavior expands deterministic startup context and user-facing hook semantics.

options.title: Approve Guarded Custom Files
options.body: Allow explicitly configured custom-basename files once the linked PR or a replacement preserves containment guards, budgets, diagnostics, session filtering, docs, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep Recognized Basenames
options.body: Leave `bootstrap-extra-files` limited to known workspace filenames and direct custom context to AGENTS.md references or explicit reads.

options.title: Defer To Broader Context API
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers choose a broader context/discovery API rather than extending this hook contract now.

recommendation.title: Approve Guarded Custom Files
recommendation.body: Allow explicitly configured custom-basename files once the linked PR or a replacement preserves containment guards, budgets, diagnostics, session filtering, docs, and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the relevant workspace/bootstrap code and was also mentioned in the issue timeline for maintainer attention.
